title: Lubbuu Boollaa
intro: Bara bulchaan gara laafina hin qabne tokko waaqolii sobaaf guutummaatti of kennuu gaafatutti deebitee deemta. Hawaasni xiqqaan lubbuuwwan of kennanii dide, adabbiin cimaan bara baraan abaaramaa ta’e isaan mudate. Seenaan isaanii karaa Qur’aana akka ragaa amantii hin sochooneetti sagalee dhageessisa. Garee jabaa kana adda baasuu dandeessaa?
clues: Biyya abbaa irree bulchaa waaqolii sobaa waaqeffannaa gaafatu jala jiraachaa turre
Hawaasni keenya Rabbiin qofatti amanuu keenya qofaaf ari’atamni cimaan isa mudate
Bulchaan kun boolli guddaan tokko akka qotamee fi abidda cimaan akka boba’u ajaje
Amantii keenya ganuu waan diddneef, tokko tokkoon boolla boba’aa sanatti darbatamne
Seenaan keenya qaama Qur’aanaa ta’ee, warri nu ari’atanis bara baraan abaaramaa turan
Suuraan rakkina keenya galmeessitu mallattoolee samii gurguddoo samiitiin moggaafame

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
